en: A vintage black-and-white postcard depicting a monumental mausoleum with a classical facade and an arched entrance. On top of the hill above the mausoleum stands a tall column with a prominent cross, and several people are seen walking on the stairs and around the site. The facade is inscribed with 'VLADISLAO VARNENSI,' and there are coats of arms visible above the lettering. The reverse side contains handwritten text in Cyrillic, date references, and cataloging numbers.
